Squaring and changing x/s,y/s variables reduces the Hilbert–Schmidt trace to 1/2 int_0^infty e^(−2s²t) J(t)/t² dt. Integrating the Lorentzian autocorrelation int [1+(u+v)²]⁻¹[1+(u+w)²]⁻¹du =2π/[4+(v−w)²] gives J=2π[t atan(t/2)−log(1+t²/4)]=2πG. G(0)=0 and G' =atan(t/2)>0, proving strict complete monotonicity of x↦T(sqrt(x)), with justified exponential differentiation. Global alternating arctan bounds integrate to the two-sided trace-square estimates and the s→infty coefficients pi/8, −pi/384, pi/1280; an independently computed exact Fraction calculation reproduces them. G(t)/t²~pi/(2t) at infinity gives pi² log(1/s)+O(1) as s→0. The effective-rank R=(pi/2)²/T is strictly increasing and asymptotic 2pi s²(1+1/(48s⁴)+...)
